# Skills

Portable [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) for the Buddhist Creator Connector. Each skill names the connector tools it uses; the contract test in `packages/connector-manifest/test` keeps those names in sync with the server.

| Skill | Use it when | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| `build-reading-list` | Build a curated, cited reading list from the WeBuddhist Library for a topic, category, tag, author or language (for example "Prajnaparamita texts with English translations" or "chants by Nagarjuna"). Use when the user asks what to read, for recommendations, a syllabus, a study plan, a bibliography, or an overview of which texts exist on a subject. | `browse_categories`, `list_tags`, `list_languages`, `search_texts`, `get_text`, `search_persons`, `get_person` |
| `cite-buddhist-text` | Quote a passage from a Buddhist text verbatim with an exact library citation (text, edition, segment reference, span). Use when the user asks to quote, cite, source, verify, locate or check the wording of a line, verse, mantra or passage from a sutra, tantra, commentary, prayer or chant, in Tibetan, English or another language, or asks "where does it say" / "what is the exact wording". | `search_texts`, `search_content`, `get_text`, `get_segment`, `read_edition`, `get_full_content` |
| `compare-translations` | Show a Buddhist text and its translation side by side, segment by segment, using the library's alignments (for example Tibetan original beside the English translation). Use when the user asks to compare translations, see the original next to a translation, check how a line was translated, or find the Tibetan for an English passage (or vice versa). | `search_texts`, `search_content`, `get_text`, `get_aligned_segments`, `get_segment`, `list_segments` |

## Install the skills alone

```bash
npx skills add TenzDelek/buddhist-creator-connector
```

The skills need the connector's tools to be useful: see [docs/install](../docs/install/) for connecting the server in your host.
